subject.title: fix(release): harden publication and supply chain

question: Should the SSH key in `.github/release-allowed-signers` be accepted as Kova’s release-signing authority, including its custody, rotation, revocation, and recovery process?
rationale: Code review can verify the signature checks, but only repository maintainers can authorize the identity controlling the key that permits release publication.

options.title: Approve this signer policy
options.body: Accept the key only after verifying its repository-controlled custody and confirming rotation, revocation, and recovery procedures.

options.title: Use a different authority
options.body: Replace the key or signing mechanism with the repository’s preferred release identity and update the contract fixtures accordingly.

options.title: Pause signed-tag publication
options.body: Keep the existing release process until an approved signer and operating policy are available.

recommendation.title: Approve this signer policy
recommendation.body: Accept the key only after verifying its repository-controlled custody and confirming rotation, revocation, and recovery procedures.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the latest repository-level release-adjacent CI policy change and is the best available owner for reconciling the trust-boundary decision.
